race.title: Grumpy & Granny's Golden Gallops Mares' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: INDANNYA did well over hurdles last season but very much appeals as the type to take her form to a higher level over fences, hence her inclusion in the Timeform Fifty To Follow. Coolanna is another who could well improve on her hurdling form now sent chasing given her pointing background. Broomfield Aderra looks to be being brought along gradually over fences and remains capable of better fitted with first-time cheekpieces. INDANNYA (FR) COOLANNA (IRE) BROOMFIELD ADERRA (IRE)
